title: Multi Agent Publishing Pipeline and Flow AI Collaboration Standard
description: Standardized protocol for Architect AI, Story AI, Flow AI Prompt generation, Image Triage into useful and not useful folders, and Compositor wiring.

style_boundary_rule.software_architecture_diagrams: Standard technical engineering diagrams only (packages, flowcharts, schemas). NEVER folk art or Madhubani style.
style_boundary_rule.book_illustrations: Modern Tech Madhubani Hybrid style reserved exclusively for storybook narrative panels and characters.
style_boundary_rule.laptop_screen_rule: Laptops, terminals, and screens must show photorealistic, syntax highlighted code (VS Code dark mode, Node.js CLI text). Never decorative squiggles on screens.

pipeline_stages: 1. Architect AI: Syllabus and concept DAG (01-ARCHITECT_AI_SYLLABUS.md)
2. Story AI: Scene script with dialogues and emotional states (02-STORY_AI_SCRIPT.md)
3. Prompt AI: Flow AI image prompts without text, with vivid emotions and 25-30% headroom (03-IMAGE_AI_PROMPTS.md)
4. Flow AI: Image generation and dropping into incoming directory
5. Triage AI: Review against 5 fatal filters and sort into organized/useful/ and organized/not_useful/
6. Compositor AI: Wire approved images from useful/ into chapter content (lessonXX.js), overlay dialogues in negative headroom, mount workbenches and 4-tier cards
7. Quality Gate AI: Run audit-chapter.mjs (>=90%), rule19-checker.mjs (100% clean), and amend_rag.py upon user confirmation

fatal_rejection_triggers: Low headroom violation (heads in top 25-30% of canvas)
Text or speech balloons baked into image art
Folk art motifs or tribal squiggles on screens or code
useful_criteria: Empty negative headroom in top 25-30% (sky, arches, rafters)
Vivid emotional expressions matching scene script
Authentic hardware and heritage architecture blend
